registration_status: Internal prospective protocol; not externally registered. Conditions motivated by the completed stationary diagnostic.
purpose: Compare adaptive policy-directed and D-optimal sampling at the previously identified stationary separations
Measure budget, probe-width, and confidence interactions
Check neighboring bilinear parameters, time-step sensitivity, and inventory initial states

bilinear.forced_exploration: k^(-1/4), balanced extreme-action mixture of nominal cost B/2
bilinear.primary_confirmatory_family: Four policy-vs-Dopt comparisons at theta=(-0.3,0.2), two budgets times two deltas; two-sided Welch tests with Holm adjustment at family level .05; direction must favor policy to support improvement. Other cells descriptive.

inventory_width.width_zero_means: baseline/candidate; other rows use only baseline and the specified smooth probe
inventory_width.allocation_rule: Estimate model, select nearest point on 16x27 cost grid, propose probe time weight min(1,0.9B/estimated_probe_cost). This budget-filling rule is not asserted to maximize the finite-budget library frontier.
inventory_width.forced_exploration: k^(-1/4); baseline/probe mixture with probe weight min(0.5,B/(2*maximum_tabulated_probe_cost))
inventory_width.scope: Mechanistic and sensitivity experiment; all width/budget/confidence cells reported. No confirmatory selection of the best observed width.

common.observation: Projected Euler with observed projection regulator; actual predictable attenuated feature used for likelihood
common.certificate: Fixed Gaussian-prior likelihood-mixture inversion; conservative continuous-parameter rectangle covers; ordinary floating-point arithmetic
common.resource_guard: Zero initial credit; attenuate proposed deviation so cumulative squared input <= B*elapsed_time at every Euler endpoint
common.randomness: Independent SeedSequence streams for every scheduled cell and repetition; base entropy 2026102504
records: All runs, including incorrect returns and administrative censoring
summaries: Restricted mean stopping time and MCSE
Uncapped expected time is not inferred from censored RMST
20,000 independent bootstrap resamples for pointwise time ratios
Errors and pointwise one-sided 95% binomial upper bounds
No pooling heterogeneous cells to estimate a common error probability
common.exclusions: Only explicit implementation smoke runs are excluded. All scheduled production runs retained. No optional stopping or increasing repetitions based on observed comparative advantage.
